text:
name: queue_steer
question: >-
  When the story queue is provider-blocked (a run of same-provider cells that makes N
  concurrent workers hammer one provider's rate limit), can a reusable operation detect the
  imbalance, interrupt the workers, re-interleave the queue round-robin, and respawn a
  provider-bounded worker set — the "interrupt + re-interleave + continue" queue-level steer?
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    model_pool:
      - deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
    context:
      motivation: >-
        On 2026-08-15 the remediation workflow's rerun phase enqueued ~33 cells in a
        single-provider block (no --interleave), and 6-8 workers hammered one provider. The
        manual fix (code: kill workers -> round-robin reorder -> respawn) is the operation this
        spec generalizes. See code_reviews/2026-08-15_self-healing-remediation-finding.md.
